title: Viksy's Modern Nether Reactor
description: The Pocket Edition Nether Reactor, brought back with style and flair!
body:
The Nether Reactor, hopefully, needs no introduction. This mod aims to re-impliment the Nether Reactor to the standards of modern Minecraft updates.

How to use it:
The recipe for the core and the structure of the reactor are the same as the original version from Pocket Edition. However, you can now use many more blocks to build the frame. Most smooth and brick forms of Stone, Blackstone, and Deepslate are usable.

Notable Changes: 
The reaction has seen a cosmetic overhaul! The texture of the core now gradually changes from one state to the next, and particles coalesce around items and mobs before they spawn! Additionally, the items that can be spawned by the reaction have been updated, rarely giving valuable items from the nether. Sometimes, the obsidian shell around the core will have a few blocks of Crying Obsidian. The reactor core, after being used, can be smelted into a single piece of netherite scrap.
